question.prompt: In \(1833.018\), what is the whole-number part, and how many thousandths are in the fractional part? Enter those two numbers in order, separated by a comma.

solutions.title: Split at the decimal point
solutions.explanation: The digits to the left of the decimal point give \(1833\). The digits to the right give \(\frac{18}{1000}\), or \(18\) thousandths.
